about: Stations: which listed Finnish stations each foreign station could affect, worked out at each station.
list: state/reference/stations.json, cleaned from Traficom's list of stations to protect (dev/tools/tables.py). Kept on this computer only.
protects: A station's receive frequency, and its transmit frequency when different, because whatever it transmits is received by someone in Finland (guidebook C-4). Each is a band of the station's width (the smaller of channel and transmission width, guidebook D-1) centred on the frequency.
basis: The same method, parameters and trigger level as the Field strength and Threshold steps, with the receiver at the Finnish station instead of the border.

outcomes.exposed: Its signal is over the trigger level at one or more listed Finnish stations on its channel.
outcomes.not_exposed: Listed Finnish stations share its channel, but its signal is under the trigger level at all of them.
outcomes.no_station: No listed Finnish station within 1,000 km shares its channel.
outcomes.no_list: This computer has no list of Finnish stations, so no station could be checked.
